Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Winning the Fight Against Spyware Merchant NSO.

Decision cutoff: 2025-05-06T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Winning the Fight Against Spyware Merchant NSO. Published date: 2025-05-06. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2025/05/winning-the-fight-against-spyware-merchant-nso.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Today’s verdict in WhatsApp’s case is an important step forward for privacy and security as the first victory against the development and use of illegal spyware that threatens the safety and privacy of everyone. Today, the jury’s decision to force NSO, a notorious foreign spyware merchant, to pay damages is a critical deterrent to this malicious industry against their illegal acts aimed at American companies and the privacy and security of the people we serve. NSO was forced to admit that it spends tens of millions of dollars annually to develop malware installation methods including through instant messaging, browsers, and operating systems, and that its spyware is capable of compromising iOS or Android devices to this day. Given how much information people access on their devices, including through private end–to-end encrypted apps like WhatsApp, Signal and others, we will continue going after spyware vendors indiscriminately targeting people around the world. Today’s ruling shows spyware companies that their illegal actions against American technologies will not be tolerated.
